# Parley v0.1.44

One feature: the permission review and the team approval now let you hand a
vendor's prompts to that vendor's own automatic reviewer. This is the piece
an unattended host team was missing.

## Approvals: you, or the vendor's reviewer

Every permission review gains an **Approvals** choice under the capability
summary. **You approve** is the vendor's ordinary prompt, exactly as before.
**Vendor's automatic reviewer** selects the vendor's own reviewer where it has
one:

- Claude: auto mode (`--permission-mode auto`). Its classifier approves
  routine actions and blocks irreversible, destructive or outward-aimed ones.
  Deny and ask rules from the profile still apply first, so a profile that
  asks before shell commands keeps asking. Plan mode leaves nothing for the
  classifier to approve, so a write-denying profile does not enable it.
- Codex: auto review (`approvals_reviewer = auto_review`), inside the same
  sandbox and approval policy as before. It grants no network or extra
  folders and can refuse.
- Copilot: assisted approval (`--assisted-approval`). It needs Copilot's
  AUTO_APPROVAL feature flag; Copilot says so if that is off.
- Agy: nothing. Agy has no reviewer, only a skip-all-permissions flag that
  Parley never passes on the host, so the picker is disabled and the review
  says why. To stop Agy asking for Parley's command, add `command(parley)` to
  the allow list in its own settings file yourself.

None of these is a bypass. Each keeps the vendor's sandbox and rules and can
still refuse, and no host launch carries a skip-all flag whichever you choose;
a check walks every vendor, both choices and two profiles to prove it. The
choice is part of the pane's remembered selection, Vendor Enforcement names
the mode, and changing it in Folder Access restarts the vendor session like
any other launch change.

## Unattended host teams

The team approval offers the same choice per host vendor under **Approvals for
host members**. It travels in the memory-only grant, reaches every member the
requester creates, and the session record shows it. A team of Claude and
Codex members approved this way runs its workflow without prompts for routine
work; Agy members still ask, and the form says so.

## Compatibility

Selections recorded before this release decode as **You approve**. Agent
protocol unchanged at 32. Existing panes keep their launch until you restart
them with a new choice.

Validated: 346 native checks, 53 Node tests, public scan, platform scan and
build. The launch check was watched failing with the choice ignored and passing
with it honoured; the grant check proves the per-vendor choice reaches a
member's launch and never Agy's.

Not validated here: a live Claude auto-mode session. Two scripted sessions
stalled at startup and were abandoned rather than spend more quota, so whether
auto mode is available to your account is what Claude itself will tell you in
the pane. The Codex flag is the one Codex documents and the one your own
config already used. Both are P2.9 in `docs/test-scenarios.md`.

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
